q: The crossed product C*-algebra C(X)⋊_f ℤ associated to a minimal dynamical system (X,f) satisfies the Giordano–Putnam–Skau theorem:
opts: C(X)⋊_f ℤ is always a commutative C*-algebra
Two minimal systems are orbit-equivalent iff their crossed products are isomorphic as C*-algebras
C(X)⋊_f ℤ determines f up to topological conjugacy
The K-theory of C(X)⋊_f ℤ is always trivial
exp: GPS (1995): orbit equivalence of minimal ℤ-systems is characterised by their crossed product C*-algebras. The K-groups K₀(C(X)⋊_f ℤ) with its order structure form a complete orbit-equivalence invariant.
